asjaajamisi teha,
astu läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Ma olen sulle suures võlgu,
{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma ei unusta

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've got nothin' but respect
for you, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 0d 00}You're on the right track.{01 00 00 05 00}
Now you've just gotta stay 
on it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Mul on sinu vastu ainult

{07 0d 00}Sa oled õigel teel.{01 00 00 05 00}
